capability.name: WARDEN static scan of MCP tool definitions
capability.description: Checks an MCP server's tool definitions (the tools/list array or the whole result) with WARDEN's static rules before a model ever sees them: injected instructions, hidden or encoded payloads, look-alike names, exfiltration hints, across names, descriptions, input and output schemas, annotations and extension metadata. Returns allow or block at the severity you choose, each finding with its tool, code and severity, the ruleset version and digest, and the RFC 8785 digest of the set (the form HISTOR records). No model, no network, no running of the server: the same deterministic scan the @aimarket/warden package runs, in HESTIA's JavaScript sandbox.

tools.description: the tools/list array, or the result object holding it (at most 500 tools)

note: WARDEN as a callable check: is this tool list safe to show a model
